entries.title: Job 22:1
segments: And Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

entries.title: Job 22:2
segments: Can a man be useful to God, as he who is wise may be useful to himself?

entries.title: Job 22:3
segments: [Is it] any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous, or gain [to Him] that you make your ways perfect?

entries.title: Job 22:4
segments: Will He reprove you because of your reverence, or enter into judgment with you?

entries.title: Job 22:5
segments: [Is] not your wickedness great, and your iniquity without measure?

entries.title: Job 22:6
segments: For you have taken a pledge from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

entries.title: Job 22:7
segments: You have not given water to the weary to drink, and you have held back bread from the hungry.

entries.title: Job 22:8
segments: But [as for] the mighty man, he had the earth, and the honored man lived in it.

entries.title: Job 22:9
segments: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

entries.title: Job 22:10
segments: Therefore snares [are] all around you, and sudden fear troubles you;

entries.title: Job 22:11
segments: or darkness, [so that] you cannot see; and a flood of waters covers you.

entries.title: Job 22:12
segments: [Is] not God high in Heaven? And behold the leading stars, for [they] are high.

entries.title: Job 22:13
segments: And you say, What does God know? Can He judge through the dark cloud?

entries.title: Job 22:14
segments: Clouds [are] a covering to Him, so that He does not see; and He walks in the circuit of Heaven.

entries.title: Job 22:15
segments: Do you keep to the old way which wicked men have walked?

entries.title: Job 22:16
segments: [They] were seized, but [there was] not time; their foundation was poured out [by] a flood;

entries.title: Job 22:17
segments: who said to God, Depart from us; and, What can the Almighty do to them?

entries.title: Job 22:18
segments: Yet He filled their houses with substance; and the wisdom of the wicked is far from me.

entries.title: Job 22:19
segments: The righteous see [it], and are glad; and the innocent laugh them to scorn.

entries.title: Job 22:20
segments: Truly our foe is not cut down, and fire has eaten their wealth.

entries.title: Job 22:21
segments: Now be of service with Him, and be at peace. Good shall come to you by them.

entries.title: Job 22:22
segments: Please receive the law from His mouth and lay up His words in your heart.

entries.title: Job 22:23
segments: If you return to the Almighty, you shall be built up; you shall put away injustice far from your tents.

entries.title: Job 22:24
segments: Then you shall lay up gold like dust, and among the rock of the torrents of Ophir.

entries.title: Job 22:25
segments: Yea, the Almighty shall be your gold and silver, [a] tower to you.

entries.title: Job 22:26
segments: For then you shall have your delight in the Almighty, and shall lift up your face to God.

entries.title: Job 22:27
segments: You shall make your prayer to Him, and He shall hear you, and you shall pay your vows.

entries.title: Job 22:28
segments: You shall also order a thing, and it shall be fulfilled to you; and the light shall shine on your ways.

entries.title: Job 22:29
segments: For they have humiliated [you], and you shall say, Pride! And He shall save the lowly of eyes.

entries.title: Job 22:30
segments: He shall deliver [one] not innocent, and will deliver by the pureness of your hands.
